positions.method: X,Z: enemy standing position = player X,Z (radar texture matching, +/-2 m) + d * (sin h, cos h), with h the radar arrow heading (rotated arrow template, 2 deg steps; heading clockwise from +Z toward +X) and d = n - 0.5 from the target nameplate range readout n. The readout is original client behaviour: client/ui/overheadwindow.pyo _UpdateEntityRange shows ceil(manifestation.body.GetDistance(entity.body)), so the true distance lies in (n-1, n]. The target sits at the crosshair near screen centre; +/-10 deg bearing tolerance covers the screen offset and arrow error. Horizontal uncertainty = sqrt(2^2 + (d tan 10deg)^2 + reading^2), reading 0.5/1.5/3.0 m for high/medium/low legibility. This is where an assaulting Thrax Infantry Initiate stood while engaged; no spawn or arrival was observed (the radar shows no hostile pips: the orange radar icons follow allied escort NPCs, see findings), so using it as a placement position assumes the enemy was placed near where it fought. Sample: t=386.6 player (307.72,66.1) heading 268 deg, range readout 22 (medium legibility); first courtyard target, killed 391.533 (A3-081); 22 also at 388.0, 10 at 391.4. Same target at 391.4: range 10 from (303.98,66.09) heading 254 -> (294.85,63.47), advancing east.
